text:
Maya Chen: quick async — Veridian Labs renewal next week but they're seeing a latency spike on production after yesterday's deploy. I opened support ticket INC-2026. What I did: triaged logs, scheduled renewal prep, notified eng. Blockers: need eng confirmation on whether deploy change caused it; renewal exec wants assurance before signing. Today: gather perf numbers + decide rollback/canary.

Liam O'Connor: looking into it now. saw a jump in p99 around 03:12 UTC. suspect change in batching from PR #4821. I pulled logs and ran a quick repro.
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-lite","input":"ping"}'
# local load test: 200rps -> p99 480ms
```
Can someone confirm customer was on rwd-lite?

Sophia Patel: Veridian is on rwd-lite, prod region us-east-1. Renewal call is Thu 11am PT, they're asking about SLA and whether we can guarantee <250ms p99. Renewal is ~120k ARR.

Carlos Rivera: I can canary-rollback PR #4821 on the serving pool for that tenant. Plan: revert canary -> monitor 15m -> escalate to full rollback if p99 doesn't drop. I also added a temporary fallback route to serve them from `redwood-mix-1` in case rollback causes regressions. Command to rollback if needed: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/serve-rwd-lite --to-revision=4820`.

Maya Chen: @Liam @Carlos please run the rollback on canary and post the perf numbers. I'll let Veridian know we're investigating and might need a brief maintenance window. Also @Jenna please join the Thu call with execs.

Liam O'Connor: rolled back canary at 03:28 UTC. quick load run after rollback: p95 120ms, p99 230ms. logs show KV-cache hits back to baseline.

SupportBot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026 (Veridian latency spike) — assigned to @Liam O'Connor and @Carlos Rivera.

Jenna Park: joining Thu. I'll prep renewal docs but will hold signature until SLA confirmation. please drop final perf numbers in this thread. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: thanks — will update Veridian with provisional timeline and ask for a 30-min buffer before the call. if numbers hold, we'll proceed with renewal talk and follow-up action items.

Liam O'Connor: follow-up: ran 10m sustained test at 180rps, p99 stabilized ~220ms. saving traces to /s3/perf/1792345678-veridian. If anything spikes again, we should consider pinning them to dedicated capacity.

Sophia Patel: noted. I'll add a renewal contingency item: "dedicated capacity option" with cost estimate.

Carlos Rivera: leaving monitoring on for 1 hour and will escalate if p99 > 300ms. set an alert rule: `alert if p99 > 300 for 5m`.

Maya Chen: great — thread summary looks good. Blocker cleared for now, tracking INC-2026 and renewal contingency. Thanks everyone.
